name: Nickelsdorf large data center site inquiry
notes: DCD and Baxtel reported a rumored large data center near Nickelsdorf on a site co-owned by the Burgenland government and economic development agency; regional entities confirmed feasibility/power-supply inquiries but no developer or formal announcement was disclosed.

name: Anexia Klagenfurt data center
notes: Anexia's company page describes its Klagenfurt data center in the south of Austria; Data Center Map lists ANEXIA Klagenfurt at Gabelsbergerstrasse 50, 9020 Klagenfurt.

name: Stadtwerke Klagenfurt Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings place the Stadtwerke Klagenfurt facility at Gabelsbergerstrasse 50a, 9020 Klagenfurt and describe it as operational since 1997.

name: Microsoft Austria East cloud region / Greater Vienna datacenters
notes: Microsoft announced/opened an Austrian cloud region launching in August 2025 with three datacenters around Vienna; trade/local reporting places them in Lower Austria, including Schwechat, with Voesendorf and Achau reported as the other sites.

name: Google Kronstorf data center
notes: Google announced and broke ground on its first Austrian data center in Kronstorf, Upper Austria, to support digital services and AI; DCD reports 42,000 sqm total, including 29,000 sqm data center space.

name: LINZ AG TELEKOM IT- und Data Center Linz 1
notes: LINZ AG TELEKOM lists IT- und Data Center Linz 1 as active since June 2025; LINZ AG press release stated the new IT and data center was opened with operation following on June 2, 2025.

name: LINZ AG TELEKOM IT- und Data Center Linz 2
notes: LINZ AG TELEKOM lists Linz 2 among its IT and Data Centers; the facility page describes a 440 sqm Linz-Urfahr data center for housing and high-availability services.

name: conova Salzburg-Maxglan data centers 4 & 5
notes: conova says its data centers 4 and 5 in Salzburg-Maxglan are among Europe's modern facilities and are ISO 27001 and EN 50600 certified; Data Center Map lists the Salzburg-Maxglan facility at Karolingerstrasse 36A.

name: conova Hallein data center 6/7
notes: conova states all of its data centers meet EN 50600; DC Hub lists conova Datacenter 6/7 in Hallein, Salzburg as operational with reported 3.0 MW power capacity.

name: Magenta Telekom Graz data center
notes: DCD reported Magenta Telekom was building a 3.6 MW, 1,120 sqm Graz data center due to open in 2022, with 380 server cabinets and room for expansion.

name: Citycom Graz data centers
notes: Citycom's company page states it operates two data centers in Graz and a backup location in Gleisdorf with ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and EN 50600 certified infrastructure.

name: myNET Datacenter III Innsbruck
notes: Aggregator listings identify myNET Datacenter III at Eduard-Bodem-Gasse 2, 6020 Innsbruck and describe myNET colocation/server-housing facilities in Innsbruck and Landeck.

name: myNET Datacenter I & II Landeck
notes: Data Center Map and Data Center Platform list myNET Datacenter I & II at Bruggfeldstrasse 5, 6500 Landeck, Tyrol.

name: Datacenter Weidach
notes: Listings and PeeringDB identify Datacenter Weidach at Weidachstrasse 10, 6900 Bregenz, operated by VTG.

name: Digital Realty Vienna campus (VIE1/VIE2/VIE3)
notes: Digital Realty's Vienna page lists three Vienna data centers with 49.3k sqm total colocation space and direct VIX/connectivity ecosystem access; VIE2 page gives 220,000 sq ft building size at Louis-Haefliger-Gasse 10.

name: NTT Vienna 1 Data Center
notes: NTT's facility page states Vienna 1 provides 8,500 sqm of server space and 15.4 MW maximum IT load; DCD reported the 2021 expansion adding about 3,000 sqm and taking capacity to about 15.2 MW.

name: A1 Next Generation Datacenter Floridsdorf
notes: A1/IBM opened the Floridsdorf facility in 2018; A1 Digital states the A1 Datacenter has 8,000 sqm building area, 2,550 sqm datacenter whitespace, 2 x 6.0 MW connected load and UPS output up to 3.9 MW.

name: Exoscale AT-VIE-1 zone at A1 Arsenal Datacenter
notes: Exoscale lists its Austria zone AT-VIE-1 as hosted by A1 Telekom Austria at Arsenal - Objekt 24 in Vienna; A1 Digital announced the Austrian Exoscale public cloud zone in A1 data centers.
